text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ loses the autumn Tenno
Sho. Even
so, she feels proud of her
performance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Tears well up in Бива Хаяхидэ's eyes as
she
realizes how much she's grown. She's
no longer
that girl who once lost to her
sister and injured
herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Together, we've perfected a winning
equation to
beat her younger sister,
Нарита Брайан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Only two months remain until we unveil
it at the
Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
